item.coloph: de ltar man ngag thugs kyi bka' yig 'di/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chab (chag) yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod pa gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog slob dpon sprul sku chen po'i (pos/)mi shig rdo rje rtsal la brgyud des shel ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan nyid la rgyud pa'i brgyud pas) dge legs 'phel//
